_comment: PC version line texts. Owner-written. Lines not listed here come from contract/script.en.json unchanged. These are the one-hand wordings proposed in contract/README.md (not yet applied to the team contract).
setup_phone: Hold the camera in front of your face. Keep your face in view.
task_arms: When the timer starts, raise your left hand beside your face and hold it there until I say swap.
repeat_arms: Let's try once more. Raise your left hand beside your face and hold it until I say swap.
swap_hands: Now lower it, and raise your right hand beside your face. Hold it there.
